speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you are experiencing sudden-onset lower back pain radiating down your leg. To help me identify the cause, please tell me: on a scale of 1 to 10, how severe is the pain, and exactly where does the radiation travel?

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old woman. The patient reports exercising in the gym several hours ago when she suddenly felt a sharp pain in her lower back. She describes the pain as radiating down the side of her leg and into her foot.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Lumbar Radiculopathy (likely L5 or S1 nerve root compression).

I have noted your age and the sudden onset of pain radiating to the foot following gym activity; to confirm the specific nerve root involved and rule out structural causes like a herniated disc, I will need to know if you have any numbness, tingling, or weakness in the leg or foot, and if coughing or sneezing makes the pain worse.
